description: Use this when a gym, studio or clinic owner wants their place on Phorme, for example after an AI check, or says "list my gym". Confirm the name, city and address with the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. It lists the place for the connected account as a draft nobody sees yet, with its page facts, and finds the map pin from the address. If the account already lists a place with that name in that city it returns that place and changes nothing. Listing is free; it takes no payment and starts no plan. It needs a connected Phorme account.

about.description: One or two plain sentences about the place, in the owner's words.

address.description: The street address. The map pin is found from it.

book_label.description: The words on its booking button, for example "Book a class".

book_url.description: The place's own booking page, starting with https://.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to listing this place.

hours.description: Opening hours, one line each, for example ["Mon to Fri, 6 am to 9 pm", "Sat, 8 am to noon"].

kind.description: What the place is: gym (also studios and boxes) or a kind of care.

lat.description: Latitude of the map pin, only to set it by hand.

line.description: One line on what the place is, in the owner's words.

lon.description: Longitude of the map pin, only to set it by hand.

name.description: The place's name, as the owner wrote it.

phone.description: The place's public phone number, as the owner gave it.

prices.description: What training at the place costs, shown on its page, in the owner's own words: one line each, for example "Drop-in 25 dollars", or { label, amount (in dollars) or amount_cents, period, note }. At most 12; an empty list clears them. Repeat them only to the owner.

request_email.description: Where booking confirmations and requests are emailed. Never shown in public.

timezone.description: The place's IANA time zone, for example "America/Chicago".

website.description: The place's own website, starting with https://.

name: create_or_claim_place

next.description: What to tell the owner next.

place.description: The place: place_id, name, kind, line, city, country, address, hours, about, book_url, request_email, prices, phone, timezone, status (draft or live), page_url, upcoming_classes, brain_id, on_plan, held_requests and plan_url (the plan on phor.me, a price-free link; null when on the plan).

title: List or claim my place
